entries.title: The Quarry

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Deluxe Edition for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with scalable resolution/settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe Edition is the best fidelity/completeness route because it combines PC capture flexibility with the full game, Gorefest Movie Mode, Death Rewind access, Horror History Visual Filter Pack, and 1980s character outfits.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Quarry Deluxe Edition on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Use PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, or Xbox One only for platform preference.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with scalable settings and Deluxe Edition bonus content.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture route and most complete package via Deluxe Edition.
skip: console route, but no sourced content advantage over PC Deluxe Edition.
skip: strong console route, but no sourced content or fidelity advantage over PC Deluxe Edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content split was identified; Deluxe Edition extras are available on PC and console storefronts, with PC preferred for fidelity/capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original release; no remake/remaster distinction applies.
